title: Catalog Assessment

notation_updates.description: Lead-adopted notation changes for this exact account under project_notation_v1. The harness generates the complete lookup from the frozen incoming view and these additions; do not author a second glossary. Historical records may omit this field.

comparison_markdown.description: Compare the actual proposals and audits against the current goal, original instructions and applicable saved answers, honoring explicitly requested stronger guarantees. Distinguish required objectives/constraints, fitted or optimized criteria, other learning or ranking strategies and optional stronger promises, including their consequential costs. A conservative ranking strategy alone need not change the scientific objective, and an inherited guarantee is not evidence of researcher preference. Preserve disagreement and identify next work. Reference proposal IDs rather than copying mathematical definitions; a mismatch requires an explicit scientific revision through the existing route, not deletion of a theorem clause or silent repair of the definition.

rationale.description: Begin with the lead's direct scientific assessment of this candidate: its strongest reason to pursue and principal criticism or limitation. Evaluate potential innovation relative to specifically cited work, strengths, unresolved evidence and the next work that would settle the main issue, with proposal, literature or finding references. Distinguish claimed novelty from established differences; if novelty or the main concern cannot yet be assessed, name the missing evidence and specific next check. Keep this evaluation separate from method_summary_markdown. A retain/exclude decision alone is not an evaluation, scientific certification or researcher selection. When a criticism is already developed in a specialist finding or the proposal limitations, cite the existing finding_id or exact proposal reference and explain how it affects the lead evaluation instead of repeating the full explanation. Use existing literature IDs for comparisons, preserve specialist attribution and disagreements, and keep a brief recap where needed for the review to stand alone.

method_summary_markdown.description: The lead's concise methodological account of this exact proposal: essential inputs, exact target and model relationships, central estimation criterion or calculation, and returned estimate, model or decision. Include key defining equations in proper Markdown/LaTeX with defined notation and keep any model-defining constraint beside its definition. State decisive conditions and the principal unresolved limitation; separate proposed benefits or guarantees from checked results. Retain the essential sequence where it defines the method without repeating the complete ordered algorithm, expanded derivatives, numerical tolerances or full tuning details; those remain in the canonical complete mathematical_definition. No fixed word, line or equation count applies. Explain the mechanism itself, not only motivation or a direction to read the original. State missing input facts and specifications honestly; do not change the original mathematics, introduce assumptions or silently complete missing steps. Preserve source references. Detailed evaluation and novelty belong in rationale.

attention_items.description: Method-specific decisions and team follow-up use affected_record_ids containing the exact method stable IDs from the actual proposals or frozen method catalog. Researcher decisions always name their affected methods. Empty scope is reserved for an explicitly phase-wide research_task. Context states the mathematical issue and source references; branch scope is never inferred from prose. Record consequential modeling choices including formulation, assumptions, policy class, data applicability and guarantee/computation tradeoffs even with complete facts and a Lead recommendation. Explain mathematical alternatives, scientific meaning, fixed quantities and decisive tradeoffs. Reuse question identities and applicable answers; do not invent preferences or force questions. Proof obligations and unambiguous repairs stay research_task items; a consequential choice about a repair may be a researcher decision. A direction requiring a changed method needs a later P2 method-revision run, or P1 revision if the shared research setting changes; it does not silently create a fourth candidate.

overview_markdown.description: A compact direct comparison of every actual candidate assessed in this run, including excluded proposals. Start with one short comparative finding or conditional recommendation and its decisive limitation; do not force a winner. Name each candidate's mathematical or statistical framework and directly contrast its central mechanism and target. Choose two or three consequential axes where supported, such as applicability conditions, inferential support or proposed computational demands, keeping only those that affect scientific interpretation or use. State shared conditions once. For three candidates, aim for roughly 120-180 words in one or two short paragraphs or a few compact bullets, expanding for necessary scientific conditions; this is a soft guide with no hard word, line or equation cap or display clipping. Favor direct contrasts and decisive limits. Do not repeat individual procedures or add proposer-role, phase-routing, workflow or permission commentary; existing authority constraints still apply outside this display prose. Detailed comparison stays in comparison_markdown and individual methodological accounts in method_summary_markdown. Do not invent rankings, target equivalence, established results or researcher preferences, rewrite definitions or select a method for the researcher. Preserve different targets, material missing evidence, source references and decisive qualifications; distinguish checked algebra, proposed guarantees and demonstrated results. Include a next scientific check or genuinely needed choice only when useful for interpreting or using the comparison. A negative or inconclusive conclusion is valid.

option_id.description: Stable option identifier of the form mod.<proposal>.<slug>.

applies_to.description: The exact proposal_id of the candidate this option modifies.

what_changes_markdown.description: The exact mathematical change to the candidate's own design choices, with defined symbols. An option is not a new method and never silently edits the proposal's attributed mathematics. Preserve each option's different target revision and any noisy-audit identification limit; explaining a modification does not adopt it.

when_preferable_markdown.description: The regime or preference under which this modification beats the proposed form.

modification_options.description: The lead's authored modification options: at least one per retained proposal, at most three per proposal; an excluded proposal may carry an option when a modification would change its disposition. Options need no answer to be useful; a consequential modeling choice qualifies for a researcher_decision under the user-inquiry reference without requiring missing study facts or an explicitly stated preference. Proposed modifications are not already published new candidates.

description: The lead's assessment of the fixed proposals and audits. Version 1.3.0 adds a per-method procedural summary distinct from the lead's evaluation. Version 1.2.0 remains readable without invented summaries; earlier records keep their original pinned schemas.
